entities.summary: Pavel Yakovlevich Golovachev was a fighter pilot with the 9th Guards Fighter Aviation Regiment of the Soviet Air Forces during the Second World War who was twice awarded the title Hero of the Soviet Union. He is credited with gaining at least 30 aerial victories.
